coverage: Existing Yaba shop bays and street edges, not a named-street reconstruction or a complete Lagos district
coordinate_policy: Metres in library; use approved native centimetre transforms. No primary layout changes.

recipes.story: Stock is arranged for today's trade; the customer edge is swept, containers show handling rather than abandonment.
rules: Keep stock in assigned bay
Cooler lid clearance and chair access retained
Avoid duplicate counters where frontage already has one
Use only approved sign/stock category

recipes.story: One tray is full, one is being sorted; a small weighing scale is accessible on the existing counter.
rules: Do not carpet every frontage with produce
Trays are empty reusable assets; fit produce to their actual inner bounds
Leave a counter working area
No authored prices or vendor claims

recipes.anchor: existing water storage or washing area
recipes.story: Stored water, a dry inverted basin and a bucket beside a clean doorstep indicate an actively maintained home.
rules: Do not imply water availability from prop presence
Ground contact required
No water gameplay or new plumbing authority
Keep entry and drainage free

recipes.anchor: approved existing facade or roof utility location
recipes.story: Different installation dates appear in weathering and repair; not every building receives every unit.
rules: Tank only on existing structurally approved support, not a new stand
AC cabinet needs fitted aperture and support; never intersect intact wall blindly
Meter box placed outside existing controls
Dish mount fitted to approved surface
Static dressing only

recipes.story: An adjustable display torso and a modest rail suggest ongoing work without inventing crowds or a new shop.
rules: Use only if existing shop function matches
Preserve stock aisle, sightlines and exits
Garments are not simulated or included; record that missing asset

recipes.anchor: approved repair bay or breakdown footprint
recipes.story: Tools remain within reach, cable is coiled after work and the usable patch is clearer than its oily edge.
rules: No new roadside service building
Avoid wires across walking path
Static equipment, no inferred mechanics
Keep lane and drain clear

recipes.story: A broom, collected sweepings and a clean walking line show active care rather than uniform decay.
rules: Broom must lean on real wall or lie with ground contact
Do not block door swing
No rubbish pile directly on clean threshold

recipes.anchor: approved work pocket outside travel route
recipes.story: A modest repair is underway, with tools stored to one side and a usable crossing left open.
rules: No dug trench, terrain change or new barrier
No simulated progress or repair mission
Wheel and feet grounded; loaded barrow variants deferred

recipes.story: Containers are stacked, shade is rolled away and the shared passage remains open.
rules: Do not add a new kiosk
Awning roll attaches to existing approved bracket
Stack crates on actual supports
Contrast worn chair with usable stock and clean counters

recipes.anchor: approved existing counter or interior bay
recipes.story: A fan faces the working position, spare stools are nested and a battery sits in an approved dry utility nook.
rules: No automatic rotation or electrical gameplay
Do not place battery terminals in public path
Retain counter access and fan floor support
Do not imply the electrical supply is live

recipes.anchor: existing approved opening or shutter hasp
recipes.story: A small secured shutter and fitted grille add hardware history without rebuilding the facade.
rules: Grille is a fixed-size accessory; fit only approved aperture dimensions
Padlock needs a real hasp; do not float it on a door
Do not close a gameplay entrance or add an access gate
No collision or access-control authority

remaining_lagos_layers: Approved local packaging and shop-specific stock
Context-specific courtyard laundry and repaired drain fittings
Vegetation tied to maintained boundaries rather than generic palm scatter
Soundscape and traffic behavior owned by core systems
